operator_goal_20261127.summary: One orchestrator steers subagents; no teams. Roles: one coding agent (backend, one picotask at a time), one code checker and dependency agent, one GUI agent (asynchronous, parallel), one specialist per question (with an adversarial pass), one eval agent. Refresh agents after each cargo build cycle. Reuse cargo; clean stale cargo only after inspection and Operator approval. Replace the egui GUI with the Vulkan shell; clean professional UI, motion where useful, no SaaS look, no text bloat, sub menus, tabs or trees. Kumihimo for windows and panels, Cabinet for file trees, Handpick as the search multitool (same behaviour as C:/Projects/LLM Projects/handshake-portal); assets are updated first by the asset dev leader thread, then adopted in the host; never remove features or adapters. Wire the GUI to internal_diagnostic and to the standalone Palmistry watcher/recorder. Many small crates per module or feature, no large crates. Resolve questions, failures and blockers without the Operator by research (online, Master Spec, product code, MTs) with at least one adversarial agent; do not guess, do not decide alone; ask the Operator only for scope, waivers, removals or claim takeovers.
